scope: Unchanged Nordic port/RTC setup: CPUID assertions, writable priority readback/raw2 mask, priority-group calculation, PendSV/RTC priority, LF-clock request, RTC31 prescaler/events/tasks/NVIC enable, critical reset, FPU and SEVONPEND setup; unexpected first-task return faults
limitations: LF-clock request is a function fixture. First-task entry is bounded or returned as a fixture to test unexpected-return behavior. NVIC writable priority bits are a controlled hardware readback. No native context transfer, physical clock/RTC or whole-image identity proof.
